about: A member's priority on one waitlist (scope-v1 module 2, decision S-D11; design prompt flows 1 and 2). A tier's weight comes from the setting waitlist.priority_weights. The black card's weight counts only on the list for the member's qualifying stake; on any other list they queue by join time with no marker. Founders' Circle counts on every list. A list is ordered by weight, highest first, then join time.

cases.description: Design prompt flow 1: a black card qualifying at 100/200 joins the 100/200 list and goes first, reason Black card.
Design prompt flow 2: the same black card on the 50/100 list queues by join time, no marker.
Same big blind, other small blind: 100/250 is not the 100/200 the card qualifies at.
A black card with no qualifying stake recorded has no priority anywhere.
Founders' Circle counts on every list, behind a black card at its stake.
A tier without a weight in the setting queues by join time.
A weight set to 0 in the setting turns the tier's priority off.
